mostWorthwhile.text: The ending’s image of a world that can keep giving is a satisfying culmination of the creation myth. It is supplied history, not an action I took.

leastWorthwhile.text: There were no gameplay actions in this final chapter to assess; its ending is brief and offers no further choices.

surprise.text: The transition from creating a world to letting its inhabitants make things of their own is an appealing change in perspective.

arbitrary.text: No action was available in this chapter, so I cannot judge any of its choices as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the world makes independently, though the ending feels complete and gives me no direct gameplay experience on which to judge another chapter.
